title: Aaron Wines
specs: Focus on Petite Sirah and coastal terroir wines from Paso Robles and San Luis Obispo Coast
Winemaker Aaron Jackson has over 20 years of experience and helped create the San Luis Obispo Coast AVA
Ohana Room reservations available for up to 8 guests
blurb: Guests visit the tasting room in Tin City, Paso Robles, to taste current release wines. Options include indoor and outdoor tastings, as well as a private Ohana Room tasting with rare library wines. The winery focuses on Petite Sirah and coastal terroir wines from the Central Coast.
extraNote: Appointment recommended due to limited space; walk-ins accepted based on availability · Ohana Room reservations must be made at least 48 hours in advance · Tasting room in Tin City, Paso Robles
